propositions: _lib_writes.py exceeds the 800-line hard module-size cap enforced by CI, blocking landing of sibling work to add optional create_ticket arguments
_lib_writes aggregates seven distinct concerns (genesis, identity/keys, status lifecycle, leaf mutations, session logs, store maintenance, signing) that should be separated into focused modules
Three-way split by concern reduces _lib_writes from 800 to 378 lines while creating _lib_mutations (280 lines) and _lib_identity (231 lines), all within the 200–500 target band
Moved names are re-exported from _lib_writes with noqa:F401 to preserve all 27 public API paths (rebar.<name> and rebar._lib_writes.<name>) without editing __init__.py, _lib_gates.py, or tests
All moved code blocks are byte-identical in the split modules with only docstrings, imports, and re-export blocks as new text, preserving exact behavior across the refactoring
